dataset_correct_over_gbif.actinote dicaeus: Altinote is a junior synonym of Actinote; molecular phylogenetics confirms synonymy
dataset_correct_over_gbif.actinote ozomene: Altinote is a junior synonym of Actinote
dataset_correct_over_gbif.elzunia humboldt: Original spelling by Latreille (1809); ICZN Art. 32 preserves original
dataset_correct_over_gbif.heliconius numata: Noun in apposition (ICZN Art. 31.2.2); all specialist literature uses 'numata'
dataset_correct_over_gbif.hypothyris leprieuri: Original single-i spelling by Feisthamel (1835); Lamas (2004) uses leprieuri
dataset_correct_over_gbif.ithomia leila: Noun in apposition; Butterflies of America, iNaturalist, and nymphalidae.net all use 'leila'
dataset_correct_over_gbif.patricia oligyrtis: 'olygyrtis' is a letter-transposition error in GBIF; 'oligyrtis' is correct
dataset_correct_over_gbif.episcada hymen: FALSE POSITIVE: E. hymen (Haensch 1905) and E. hymenaea (Prittwitz 1865) are different valid species
dataset_correct_over_gbif.hyalyris schlingeri: Correct genus is Hyalyris Boisduval 1870 (with y); Hyalaris is a GBIF error
dataset_correct_over_gbif.anteros bracteata: Dataset follows specialist usage; GBIF form is listed as DOUBTFUL
dataset_correct_over_gbif.euptychia westwoodi: Dataset follows specialist usage; GBIF form is listed as SYNONYM
dataset_correct_over_gbif.eurybia nicaeus: Dataset follows specialist usage; GBIF form is listed as DOUBTFUL
